notes: The prompt card is cut off in both modes: MC ends mid-sentence at "One angle" and keypad slices a line in half, so "measures 24 degrees. What is the other angle" is never shown. Only the diagram's 24 and ? labels keep it solvable.

The prompt card is pushed off the bottom of the scroll area by the tall grid, leaving a blank sliver, so the rule (x, y) -> (x - 2, y - 1) and the fact that C' is wanted are both invisible. The translated image is also already drawn as a dashed triangle, so the answer can be read straight off the grid.

Only the top halves of one line of the prompt are visible below the grid; "Reflect the triangle across the x-axis. What are the coordinates of B'?" is unreadable in MC. The reflected image is pre-drawn dashed, so (-4, -5) can be read off the grid without reflecting anything.

The prompt is clipped to the top halves of its first line, so the rotation amount and direction (90 counter-clockwise) and the target vertex are lost. The rotated image is already drawn dashed on the grid, making the answer a read-off rather than a rotation.

The prompt card renders as an empty sliver, so the scale factor 2 and target vertex B' are never shown. The grid spans -9..9 while the triangle only spans about 4 units, so it sits tiny in the middle with the B, C and 0 labels overlapping.

The prompt "Are these two figures congruent?" is scrolled off into a blank sliver, leaving two unexplained triangles above four yes/no choices. The "Yes - same size and same shape" label also runs flush into both edges of its pill.

The prompt card is entirely gone and the grid itself is cut off at the bottom (the -6 label is sliced), so nothing states the question. Both long choices overflow their pills - "Yes - same shape (corresponding sides in proportion)" and "No - corresponding sides are NOT in proportion" start left of the pill border.

The ? is drawn inside the triangle at vertex C, i.e. on the interior angle (38), while the expected answer is the exterior angle 142; 38 is offered as a choice, so a student reading the diagram is graded wrong. The prompt is also truncated in both modes, MC stopping at "What is the measure of", which removes the only text that said "exterior".

No diagram at all for a concept that is about identifying which angle is the alternate interior one, leaving a large blank area above the prompt; the question reduces to knowing the vocabulary. The explanation also starts lowercase ("alternate interior angles are equal...").

The prompt says "the dimensions shown" but only two of the three are labelled (6 on the front bottom edge, 7 on the right edge); the height, also 6, has no label, so 11 cannot be derived from the diagram. The top-back corner of the box is also clipped by the top of the diagram area.
"What is the distance from A to B?" never appears: in MC the card is a blank sliver and in keypad mode it is missing entirely, so the keypad screen is a bare grid with two dots and a number pad.

Keypad mode: the canonical answer is "+18" and checkAnswer accepts only the exact string for integer format, so a kid who types 18 (the natural input, and the same number) is marked wrong even though the pad offers no hint that the + is required. The prompt wording is also mangled - "Sofia is above sea level 18 meters" should read "Sofia is 18 meters above sea level".
The explanation "The marked point is at 2." only restates the answer instead of showing how to count ticks from 0. The negative tick labels collide at the left end, rendering as "-10-9 -8".
